in_marathi.name: Jyotiprakash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of the God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotiprakash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyoti means light and Prakash means visible or manifest. The name Jyotiprakash signifies the one who is the visible or manifest form of the divine light.

in_bengali.name: Jyotiprakash
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Light of the God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jyotiprakash একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jyoti means light and Prakash means visible or manifest. The name Jyotiprakash signifies the one who is the visible or manifest form of the divine light.
